subject: Mr Blogmaster
author: ichienkai
body:
Yo Bootleg!  Calm down with the brown trousers thing man - i never said i believed anything on that short video on youtube!  Granted the very last one is quite spooky but if you look closely you can see the little girls eye in the mirror has been doctored so i'm not THAT gullible dude!!

 Women and cats will do as they please, and men and dogs should relax and get used to the idea.
